exercises.instructionEn: Label the pictures with words from the list.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (16 ta so'z):
  saucer, bacon, bread, butter, chips, cream, eggs,
  fish, fork, fruit, knife, pepper, salt, strawberries,
  vegetables, cup

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a saucer /ˈsɔːsə/ = likopcha (chashka ostidagi tarelka)
  cream = qaymoq, smetana
  a fork = vilka
  a knife /naɪf/ = pichoq ('k' o'qilmaydi)

DIQQAT — 9 va 16-RASMNI FARQLANG:
  9-rasm  — savatdagi SABZAVOTLAR (vegetables)
  16-rasm — vazadagi MEVALAR (fruit): banan, uzum, olma

answers.descUz: 7-rasm: suzgichlari va dumi bor butun dengiz jonivori

exercises.instructionEn: Use the words from a) to complete these collocations as in the examples.
exercises.instructionUz: a) qismidagi so'zlardan foydalanib bu birikmalarni to'ldiring, namunalardagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
COLLOCATIONS (turg'un birikmalar) —
birga ishlatiladigan so'z juftliklari.

Bu juftliklarni ALOHIDA emas, BIRGA yodlash kerak —
ingliz tilida ular DOIM shu tartibda keladi.

DIQQAT — TARTIB O'ZGARMAYDI:
  'cup and saucer' TO'G'RI
  'saucer and cup' g'alati eshitiladi

KITOBDA BERILGAN: 1 va 2-bandlar.

Har bir chiziqcha bitta HARFNI bildiradi —
shunga qarab so'zni topish oson.

items.textEn: 1  c u p  and  s a u c e r
items.whyUz:
Kitobda BERILGAN namuna.
'a cup and saucer' = chashka va likopcha (birga sotiladi).

items.textEn: 2  b a c o n  and  e g g s
items.whyUz:
Kitobda BERILGAN namuna.
'bacon and eggs' — an'anaviy ingliz nonushtasi.

'fish and chips' = baliq va kartoshka fri.
Britaniyaning eng mashhur taomi.
Coursebook 58-betdagi menyuda ham bor edi (£2.75).

'a knife and fork' = pichoq va vilka.
DIQQAT: birgalikda BITTA artikl bilan: 'a knife and fork'.
Coursebook 58-betda ham bor edi.

items.hintUz: Britaniyaning yozgi an'anaviy shirinligi (12 va 5 harf)
items.whyUz:
'strawberries and cream' = qulupnay va qaymoq.
Britaniyada yozda, ayniqsa Uimbldon tennis turnirida yeyiladi.

items.hintUz: Nonushtaning eng oddiy taomi (5 va 6 harf)
items.whyUz:
'bread and butter' = non va sariyog'.
IDIOMA: 'bread and butter' = asosiy daromad manbai.

'salt and pepper' = tuz va qora qalampir.
Har qanday dasturxonda birga turadi.

'fruit and vegetables' = meva va sabzavot.
DIQQAT: 'fruit' — SANALMAYDIGAN (odatda -s siz),
'vegetables' esa DOIM ko'plikda.

exercises.instructionEn: Write the words from Ex. 1 in the correct boxes.
exercises.explanationUz:
UCH KATAK:

  a / an  →  SANALADIGAN, BIRLIKDA (4 ta so'z)
  some (plural)  →  SANALADIGAN, KO'PLIKDA (4 ta so'z)
  some (uncountable)  →  SANALMAYDIGAN (8 ta so'z)

Jami 16 ta so'z.

KITOBDA BERILGAN:
  a/an katagida — cup
  some (plural) katagida — chips
  some (uncountable) katagida — bacon

QANDAY ANIQLASH:
  Ro'yxatda so'z -S bilan tugaganmi?
     ha  → some (plural)
  Bitta buyum va sanash mumkinmi?
     ha  → a/an
  Massa, suyuqlik yoki kukunmi?
     ha  → some (uncountable)

items.whyUz:
Kitobda BERILGAN: 'a cup'.
SANALADIGAN BIRLIK.

'a saucer' — SANALADIGAN BIRLIK.
Bitta likopcha, ikkita likopcha — sanash mumkin.
'a fork' — SANALADIGAN BIRLIK.

'a knife' — SANALADIGAN BIRLIK.
Ko'pligi: KNIVES.

Kitobda BERILGAN: 'some chips'.
SANALADIGAN, KO'PLIKDA.

'some eggs' — SANALADIGAN, KO'PLIKDA.
Bittasi: 'an egg'.

'some strawberries' — SANALADIGAN, KO'PLIKDA.
Bittasi: 'a strawberry'.

'some vegetables' — SANALADIGAN, KO'PLIKDA.
Bittasi: 'a vegetable'.

Kitobda BERILGAN: 'some bacon'.
SANALMAYDIGAN (massa).

'some bread' — SANALMAYDIGAN.
Sanash uchun: 'a loaf of bread', 'a slice of bread'.

'some butter' — SANALMAYDIGAN.
'a butter' XATO.

'some cream' — SANALMAYDIGAN.
'cream' = qaymoq, smetana.

'some fish' — OVQAT sifatida SANALMAYDIGAN.
DIQQAT: JONIVOR sifatida sanaladi ('three fish'),
lekin ovqat sifatida 'some fish' deyiladi.

'some fruit' — SANALMAYDIGAN (umumiy so'z).
'I eat a lot of FRUIT' — 'fruits' emas.
Alohida mevalar esa sanaladi: 'two apples'.

'some pepper' — ZIRAVOR sifatida SANALMAYDIGAN.
DIQQAT: 'a pepper' (bulg'or qalampiri, sabzavot) esa SANALADI.

'some salt' — SANALMAYDIGAN.
'a salt' XATO.

exercises.instructionEn: Say what there is/are in the pictures in Ex. 1.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNALAR:
  S1: There IS A knife.
  S2: There ARE SOME eggs.
  S3: There IS SOME butter.

UCH QOLIP:
  SANALADIGAN BIRLIK  → There IS A/AN ...
  SANALADIGAN KO'PLIK → There ARE SOME ...
  SANALMAYDIGAN       → There IS SOME ...

DIQQAT — FE'L SHAKLI:
  Faqat KO'PLIKDA 'are' bo'ladi.
  Sanalmaydigan ot BIRLIK hisoblanadi → IS.

example.speaker: a/an bilan
example.en: There is a cup. There is a saucer. There is a fork.
example.uz: Chashka bor. Likopcha bor. Vilka bor.

example.speaker: some (plural) bilan
example.en: There are some chips. There are some strawberries. There are some vegetables.
example.uz: Kartoshka fri bor. Qulupnaylar bor. Sabzavotlar bor.

example.speaker: some (uncountable) bilan
example.en: There is some bacon. There is some bread. There is some cream.
example.uz: Bekon bor. Non bor. Qaymoq bor.

example.speaker: some (uncountable) bilan
example.en: There is some fish. There is some fruit. There is some salt. There is some pepper.
example.uz: Baliq bor. Meva bor. Tuz bor. Qalampir bor.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct preposition from the list.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: at, for, from, in, on, to, with

PREDLOGLARNING ASOSIY VAZIFALARI:

  AT  — aniq nuqta: at the office, at 10 o'clock,
        at night, at the weekend, at the end of
  IN  — ichida: in the fridge, in the Philippines
  ON  — yuzasida: on the table, on your plate
  TO  — yo'nalish: go TO the restaurant
  FOR — maqsad/kim uchun: a table FOR two, FOR dinner
  FROM — boshlanish nuqtasi: open FROM 8 pm
  WITH — bilan: pasta WITH sauce, eat WITH friends

Bu mashqdagi gaplar Coursebook 54–59-betlardan olingan.

items.textEn: 1  I usually have lunch ............ the office when I've got a lot of work to do.
items.whyUz:
Kitobda BERILGAN javob: AT.
'AT the office' = ishxonada (ish joyi sifatida).
Coursebook 58-betda braziliyaliklar ishxonada tushlik QILMAYDI.

items.textEn: 2  The restaurant is open ............ 8 pm till midnight.
items.whyUz:
'FROM ... TILL ...' = ...dan ...gacha.
Coursebook 55-betda ham bor edi:
'open from eleven in the morning till eleven in the evening'.

items.textEn: 3  I'd like to book a table ............ two people, please.
items.whyUz:
'a table FOR two people' = ikki kishilik stol.
'for' — kim uchun ekanini bildiradi.
Coursebook 59-betda: 'Table for two?'

items.textEn: 4  My favourite food is pasta ............ tomato sauce.
items.whyUz:
'pasta WITH tomato sauce' = pomidor sousli makaron.
Coursebook 55-betdagi Laura's menyusida ham bor edi.

items.textEn: 5  Is there any milk ............ the fridge?
items.whyUz:
'IN the fridge' = muzlatgich ichida.
Coursebook 57-betda ham bor edi.

items.textEn: 6  Shall I put the plates ............ the table?
items.whyUz:
'ON the table' = stol ustida.
'Shall I ...?' = ...ayinmi? (taklif qilish).

items.textEn: 7  Would you like to go ............ the new Chinese restaurant ............ dinner tonight?
items.whyUz:
'go TO + joy' — yo'nalish.
'FOR dinner' = kechki ovqatga (maqsad).
'go to a restaurant FOR dinner' — o'zgarmas qolip.

items.textEn: 8  Brazilians have dinner ............ about 10 o'clock ............ night.
items.whyUz:
'AT about 10 o'clock' — aniq soat oldida AT.
'AT night' — ISTISNO ibora ('in the night' emas).
Coursebook 58-betdagi Braziliya matnidan.

items.textEn: 9  ............ the Philippines, it's polite to leave a little food ............ your plate ............ the end of a meal.
items.whyUz:
'IN the Philippines' — mamlakat oldida IN.
'ON your plate' — tarelka yuzasida ON.
'AT the end of a meal' — 'at the end of' o'zgarmas ibora.
Coursebook 58-betdagi Filippin matnidan.

items.textEn: 10  Finnish people sometimes eat ............ their friends ............ the weekend.
items.whyUz:
'eat WITH their friends' = do'stlari bilan ovqatlanmoq.
'AT the weekend' — britancha (amerikacha 'on the weekend').
Coursebook 58-betdagi Finlandiya matnidan.

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the table with words from the list.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (14 ta so'z):
  banana, beef, coffee, ham, lettuce, milk, onion,
  orange, pear, sausage, tea, Coke, cherry, carrot

TO'RT GURUH:
  Fruit (meva) ......... 4 ta
  Vegetables (sabzavot)  3 ta
  Meat (go'sht) ........ 3 ta
  Drinks (ichimlik) .... 4 ta

YANGI SO'Z:
  beef /biːf/ = mol go'shti

DIQQAT: 'Coke' — BOSH HARF bilan (marka nomi).

items.hintUz: Daraxt va butalarda o'sadigan shirin mahsulotlar
items.whyUz:
MEVALAR: banan, apelsin, nok, gilos.
Hammasi SANALADIGAN otlar.
DIQQAT: 'fruit' umumiy so'z sifatida SANALMAYDI.

items.hintUz: Taom uchun pishiriladigan yoki salatga qo'shiladigan o'simliklar
items.whyUz:
SABZAVOTLAR: salat bargi, piyoz, sabzi.
DIQQAT: 'lettuce' — SANALMAYDIGAN,
'onion' va 'carrot' esa SANALADIGAN.

ICHIMLIKLAR: qahva, sut, choy, kola.
Hammasi SANALMAYDIGAN (suyuqlik).
Sanash uchun: 'a cup of coffee', 'a glass of milk'.

groups.explanationUz: Bu juftliklar DOIM shu tartibda keladi — birga yodlanadi.

groups.ruleUz: Bir so'z, ikki ma'no — sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan

patterns.exampleEn: There is a knife. There is a cup.
There are some eggs. There are some strawberries.
There is some butter. There is some bread.
patterns.explanationUz:
Sanalmaydigan ot BIRLIK hisoblanadi → IS + SOME.
'There ARE some butter' XATO.

patterns.exampleEn: bread and butter, salt and pepper, fish and chips
patterns.exampleUz: non va sariyog', tuz va qalampir, baliq va kartoshka fri
patterns.explanationUz: Bu juftliklarni ALOHIDA emas, BIRGA yodlang.
